description: Package A: CI's Create + Flywheel smoke job (ci/create-smoke.py): the core world with Create Fly (which carries Flywheel) on the server and the client, one scene of Create machines drawn through Flywheel; checked for no errors and no crash, and for Quicksilver's Flywheel compatibility (package 5) being on. No picture comparison.

scenes.title: Create machines on a platform (package A's Create + Flywheel smoke scene): a creative motor turning shafts, a large and a small cogwheel, a gearbox and an encased fan, and a second motor under a mechanical bearing with planks on it
